title: The solarpunk canal
alt: A lush coral-coloured canal city with solar awnings, boats and pedestrian bridges.
description: A detailed hand-painted solarpunk environment with lively planted terraces.
prompt: A vivid hand-painted solarpunk cityscape with lush terraced apartments, solar awnings, small boats on a clear canal, lively planted balconies and pedestrian bridges. Warm coral masonry, turquoise water and abundant emerald plants create a richly layered panoramic scene. The bridges connect to plausible paths and the boats have coherent hulls. Gentle morning haze, sophisticated animation-background artistry, no readable writing.
